name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo Mendoza's path to motorsport finance was paved with a blend of passion and meticulous accounting. Born and raised in Buenos Aires, Ricardo honed his financial acumen at the Universidad de Buenos Aires, later earning his CPA. Early in his career, he worked for a large agricultural firm, but the roar of engines always called to him. He started volunteering at local racing events, eventually landing a role managing the finances of a small touring car team. 

Ricardo believes in a proactive, transparent approach to financial management. He's not just about crunching numbers; he sees himself as a partner to the team, providing insights and strategies to optimize resources. He prides himself on his ability to identify potential risks and opportunities, ensuring the team's financial stability and enabling it to invest wisely in performance upgrades. His dedication and clear communication style are what makes him a trusted and valued member of any team.

physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a warm, inviting smile that hints at his approachable nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down financial ideas, even during races.
Insists on using a vintage calculator for complex calculations, claiming it's 'more reliable'.
Has a framed photo of Juan Manuel Fangio on his desk.
